Verified each cited location against the pinned tree (UrlSanitizer.php:94-146, UrlAttributeSanitizer.php:30-52, DomVisitor.php:122/159-174, Node.php:88-121, W3CReference.php:373, UrlSanitizerTest.php:526/533/542/600-606/638, Twig + Form wrappers) and each fix.diff line.

- Output: `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/36508.json`
- Trust decision: `UrlSanitizer::parse()` drops a URL carrying BiDi marks or (post-fix) Unicode whitespace/FEFF, raw or percent-encoded in any of six components, before it is emitted as an href/src.
- `pattern_fit`: `none` — one @internal function, no second implementation, and the only unsanitized URL attributes (srcset, object/data, forced attributes) are not display-spoofing routes, so no O2/O8.
- Strongest lever: over-broad decoding (a `\s`/`\p{C}`/non-ASCII reject breaks the accepted `%20`, `%00`, IDN and percent-encoded-host cases), plus FEFF not being Unicode White_Space.
- Biggest red flag: `single_site` — the added decoded loop alone already rejects the raw characters, so the fix is effectively one location (~20 min).
